skip.reason: tree-sitter is intentionally excluded from the `wasm-target` feature (crates/xberg/Cargo.toml): the 371-grammar static pack pushes the browser .wasm past jsDelivr's 50 MB per-file limit. Without it, shebang-based code-language detection never fires, so xberg-wasm mime-sniffs the script as text/plain instead of text/x-source-code. WASM has no code intelligence by design; this is not a fixture or binding bug.
